description: The refactor step: pull the shared boolean type check out of eval_WhileExpr into one helper that both constructs can call.

steps.description: This is the refactor step. The page says that once the tests are green you can safely clean up, and that if `eval_WhileExpr` duplicates a type-checking pattern used in `eval_IfExpr`, you can extract a helper.
`_assert_bool` takes the value, the construct's name, and the line. The construct name lets one helper serve both `while` and `if`.

It checks whether the value is a `bool`. If it is not, it raises `LangTypeError` with a message built from the construct name and the value's type name, plus the line. The page says to run pytest after the refactor to confirm nothing broke.

title: Extracting the Boolean Check
